libraryPreparationPreflight.agent_guidance: Bootstrap Hibernate through a `META-INF/persistence.xml` persistence unit backed by an H2 in-memory JDBC URL. Set `hibernate.bytecode.provider=none` (for example in `hibernate.properties`) to avoid bytecode-provider requirements during native-image-oriented tests. Exercise dialects with H2 modes rather than Docker databases.

deterministic_setup.reason: Hibernate does not bundle a JDBC driver; H2 enables self-contained in-memory EntityManagerFactory and dialect coverage.
PostgreSQLDialect initialization references PostgreSQL driver types even when tests use H2 PostgreSQL mode.
OracleDialect initialization references Oracle JDBC types even when tests use H2 Oracle mode.

input_evidence.name: issue
input_evidence.summary: #9119 Improve coverage for org.hibernate:hibernate-core:6.1.0.Final; label=library-update-request; body_chars=198

risks: H2 compatibility modes do not fully reproduce PostgreSQL, Oracle, MySQL, MariaDB, or SQL Server behavior; Local Gradle and Native Image verification must determine whether real database coverage is required.
libraryPreparationPreflight.summary: Hibernate Core needs an explicit JDBC driver for meaningful JPA bootstrapping; existing coverage also initializes PostgreSQL and Oracle dialects against H2 compatibility modes.
